title: Is the PS5 Pro Worth It? What Reviewers Say
description: Is the PS5 Pro worth it over a standard PS5? What reviewers said about its upscaling and performance, the missing disc drive, and who should actually upgrade.
h1: Is the PS5 Pro worth it? What reviewers say
intro: Sony’s more powerful PS5 launched in November 2024 to strong graphics and a divisive price. Here’s the reviewer consensus, and who it actually suits.

image.alt: A white PlayStation console and controller

cardText: Upscaling, performance and the missing disc drive: who should upgrade.

sections.html: The PS5 Pro has a more powerful graphics chip, a 2TB drive and PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), Sony’s AI upscaling. In supported games you can get sharper images and smoother frame rates at the same time.
It launched at $699.99 in the US without a disc drive; the add-on drive and vertical stand are sold separately. If you already have a PS5 Slim drive, it works with the Pro.

Digital Trends called it a worthwhile upgrade for tech enthusiasts that most people can live without. Laptop Mag described it as Sony’s most divisive console. Reviewers agreed the gains show most on a large 4K TV, and are subtle at normal viewing distances.

• Yes: enthusiasts with a big 4K TV who care about image quality.
  • No: casual players, 1080p TV owners, and anyone happy with their PS5.
